name: Saikyo Haraigoshi

boost.name: Peek
effect: Look at the top card of your deck. You may Strike. If you do not, add it to your gauge.
HIT: Discard up to 3 cards at random from your hand. For each card discarded, Pull 1 and gain +1 Power.

name: Dankukyaku

boost.name: Saikyo Leap
effect: Move 3, then add a card from your hand to your gauge.
BEFORE: Advance 3. If you moved past the opponent during this movement, this attack does not hit.
AFTER: Place a card from your hand on top of your deck.

name: Koryuken

boost.name: Saikyo Glory
effect: CLEANUP: If you are not stunned, you may sustain this Boost.
HIT: Discard the top card of your deck. This attack has +Power equal to the discarded card's printed Power.

name: Gadouken

boost.name: Saikyo Vision
effect: Look at the opponent's hand. Discard any number of cards from your hand, then Strike.
AFTER: If you hit, you may return this card to the top of your deck. If you do, add a card from your hand to your gauge.

name: Shisso Buraiken

boost.name: Lucky!
effect: Place a card from your hand on top of your deck. You may skip your draw step this turn.
If you have no cards in hand, ignore this card's Gauge Cost.

name: Legendary Taunt

boost.name: Secret Technique
effect: Search your deck for any card and add it to your hand. Discard until you have one card in hand. You may skip your draw step this turn.
BEFORE: Advance up to 3. You may draw a card. Then, you may play and execute another attack from your hand (carrying out all its Before, Hit, and After triggers).

name: Haoh Gadouken

boost.name: Saikyo Power
effect: HIT: If you have no cards in hand, +4 Power.
If you have no cards in hand, ignore this card's Gauge Cost.
Attacks at range 2 to 5 do not hit you.
